findings.title: Existing realms never receive the new Clients schema
findings.body: Adding `Clients` here only affects initialization of a new admin-permissions resource server. `init()` returns immediately when the realm already has an admin-permissions client, so realms that enabled FGAP V2 before this change will not get the Clients resource or its scopes. Client permissions then cannot be created or evaluated in those realms, leaving this feature unavailable unless the admin-permissions schema is migrated for existing clients.
